title: Small labels, settling in Los Angeles and returning home
summary: He recorded for Freedom and National without caring who owned them and came home to stay with his mother.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Then I started recording for a coupla little jumped-up labels was around. One was Freedom Records. Other one was National...and a few more of the recordings we done.
Now, don't ask me. I never wasn't that worried about who owned them. All I wanted was the money. I was takin' it easy. I didn't ask no questions.

Alla say, "You wanta record?"
I say, "Yeah!"
"You got somethin' t'record?"
"Yeah."
"Got some o' your own stuff?"
"Yeah!"

So we done all that, an' we wound up recordin' all them on all them different labels. So, finally, I got tired o' all that, runnin' around all over the country so I came back home again in Los Angeles and stayed with my mother, and I been here ever since. I been workin' all up in 'Frisco...all the way to Seattle, Washington...been playin' all them different places...an' I been takin' it kinda easy. I ain't been doin' too much here lately...just tryin' to make ends meet, and then I hauled off and got married again.
